q074.question: Both ConocoPhillips and ExxonMobil discuss their production volumes in their 10-Ks. Compare their daily production (in barrels of oil equivalent per day) for the most recent fiscal year.
q074.previous_question: Both ConocoPhillips and ExxonMobil discuss their production volumes in their 10-Ks. Compare their daily production (in barrels of oil equivalent per day) for the most recent fiscal year.
q074.answer: ExxonMobil averaged approximately 4.7 million oil-equivalent barrels per day in 2025, versus ConocoPhillips 2,375 MBOED (2.375 million BOE/day). ExxonMobil produced approximately 1.98 times as much.
q074.previous_answer: ExxonMobil produces significantly more than ConocoPhillips (approximately 3.7M+ BOE/d vs ~1.7M BOE/d). Verify from production disclosures in the 10-Ks.
q074.interpretation: MBOED means thousand barrels of oil equivalent per day; compare total production, not oil-only volumes.
